title: Anthropic launches free Claude Code prompt library with 100+ #anthropic #claudecode #aidevelopment
description: Anthropic released the official Claude Code prompt library, offering a free collection of over 100 templates used by their engineers. These prompts include reusable skills via slash commands, a plan mode activated by Shift + Tab to outline projects, and a Claude.md file that teaches Claude your project's conventions automatically. This resource streamlines coding with Claude AI by reducing repetitive prompts and enhancing workflow efficiency. By adopting these engineered rules, developers can optimize AI collaboration, speeding up project planning and maintaining consistent coding standards across sessions. The free template library reflects a broader trend in AI tooling that empowers users with customizable, scalable prompts to boost productivity in software development. #Anthropic #ClaudeCode #AIprogramming #AIPrompts #DeveloperTools #ArtificialIntelligence #CodingWithAI #ClaudeAI #AIworkflow #TechInnovation #SoftwareDevelopment #AIPromptLibrary #MachineLearning #CodingEfficiency #DeveloperResources
